display_long_description:
# **Bring dinosaurs back to life in your own space. 🦖**
Assemble giant skeletons **bone by bone** in a polished mixed-reality puzzle featuring **dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures**, now with improved gameplay, a new desk shape, a transparent desk for life-size viewing, and an unlockable multi-dinosaur scene: Triceratops in Danger.

Start with **5 iconic creatures**, including **Tyrannosaurus Rex and Pteranodon**, then expand your lab with new dinosaur and prehistoric creature packs.
>
# 🦴 Turn your room into a dinosaur lab.
[media]
Rebuild prehistoric giants **bone by bone** in mixed reality.
Open fossil packs, place each bone, and watch the skeleton slowly take shape in front of you.
>
# 📏 Life-Size Dinosaur Reveal
[media]
Once completed, watch them appear at **full, life-size scale** iin your own environment, as a skeleton or brought to life with its skin.
>
# 💡Multiple Difficulty Levels
[media]
Each species includes **four difficulty levels**, from accessible puzzles to expert reconstruction challenges with **all bones in one bag** and optional hints.
>
# 🧠 Learn as You Build
[media]
As each bone finds its place, **scientific insights appear**, revealing how dinosaur skeletons were structured and discovered.

🌿 Each puzzle now includes a miniature decor to make your fossil lab feel more alive.
>

# 💬 Join our Discord 
Follow upcoming dinosaurs, share feedback, and connect with other players.

**👉 discord.gg/PW2Qwavp4d**
